summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Vox Populi ETF (VOXP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of approximately 500 of the largest companies listed in the US. It weights companies based on market sentiment through a proprietary web-based algorithm. VOXP was launched on Nov 3, 2022 and is issued by Vox.

holdings.infoBox: VOXP is an equity ETF with a total of 507 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.42%, Apple at 6.88%, Alphabet at 5.52%, Microsoft at 4.90%, and Amazon.com at 3.88%.
